channel.title: The Veridian Protocol — Web Novel
channel.description: A Sci-Fi/Dark Fantasy series about blood-tech, AI consciousness, and humanity's fight for freedom.

item.title: Chapter 1: The Glitch in the Blood
item.description: Kael discovers he can interface with machines through blood magic without sacrificing his own vitality.

item.title: Chapter 2: The Crimson Circuit
item.description: Kael meets a secret society of blood-tech practitioners who reveal he's a Null Conduit.

item.title: Chapter 3: Fragments of the Old World
item.description: Kael uncovers ancient server relics that predate the Collapse, containing AI echoes.

item.title: Chapter 4: The Witch of Sector 7
item.description: Alliance with a cybernetic sorceress who teaches him to read the static between worlds.

item.title: Chapter 5: Protocol Zero
item.description: The megacorporation discovers his ability and marks him for extraction.

item.title: Chapter 40: The Last Page
item.description: The final chapter. Kael and Vera step through the doorway into infinity.
